name: ziwei-doushu
description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
one_liner: A free, open-source engine (plus a massive dataset of interpretations) for casting and reading Chinese astrology charts — the kind of fortune-telling millions of Chinese speakers pay apps for.
buyer: A Chinese-language app developer or content creator who wants to launch a fortune-telling or astrology app for a market that already spends real money on this, without building the chart-casting engine and interpretation content from scratch.
business_use_cases: A developer builds a consumer astrology app for Chinese-speaking users, charging for detailed readings while using this engine and dataset as the core free tier.
A content creator or matchmaking service offers personalized chart readings as a paid add-on to an existing dating or lifestyle app.
A wellness or life-coaching business in Chinese-speaking markets adds 'AI-assisted' astrology readings as a premium upsell to existing consultations.

money_ideas.idea: Launch an app offering free basic charts with paid in-depth readings or yearly forecasts, since the underlying engine and content are free to use.
Offer a subscription for ongoing personalized forecasts (monthly/yearly updates) built on the dataset.

steal_this: Wire the engine to a simple chat interface this weekend and offer free basic readings to build an audience before adding paid in-depth reports.
